Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 26
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly asserted as a “verified fact” that the first National Geographic short on YouTube was “Human Origins 101” (2018), anchoring the team to the wrong video. This misidentification led all subsequent searches astray, prevented correctly identifying what “#9” referred to or checking the proper Monterey Bay Aquarium source, and directly resulted in the incorrect final answer.
